title: Spectroscopic Investigation of Emetine-DNA Binding.
authors: Udeochu, Uche; Smith, Carin; Kong, Srey; Adebayo, Adenike; Franklin, Juliet; Bakare, Oladapo
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过光谱实验和分子对接考察小分子吐根碱与B-DNA的沟槽结合，虽非TF-DNA体系，但涉及蛋白-DNA互作可借鉴的分子对接与结合模式分析方法。
abstract: Emetine, a natural isoquinoline alkaloid with broad pharmacological potential, interacts with DNA through specific noncovalent mechanisms. Using UV-vis spectroscopy, FTIR spectroscopy, and molecular docking, this study examined the mode and energetics of emetine-DNA association. UV-vis spectra displayed pronounced hypochromic and bathochromic shifts upon DNA titration, indicating strong chromophore-base pair interactions. The binding constant (K = 1.10 x 10(6) M(-1)) and Gibbs free energy (DeltaG degrees  = -8.26 kcal.mol(-1)) confirm a spontaneous, moderately strong interaction. FTIR analysis revealed perturbations in guanine and phosphate vibrations, consistent with hydrogen bonding and pi-pi stacking effects. Docking simulations with B-DNA (PDB: 1BNA) identified a low-energy binding pose (DeltaG = -7.13 kcal.mol(-1)), positioning emetine within the DNA minor groove and forming hydrogen bonds with guanine DG4. Together, spectroscopic and computational data support a minor groove-associated binding model and establish a foundation for future high-resolution structural studies of emetine-DNA interactions.
abstract_zh: 吐根碱（Emetine）是一种具有广泛药理潜力的天然异喹啉生物碱，通过特定的非共价机制与DNA相互作用。本研究利用紫外-可见光谱（UV-vis spectroscopy）、傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR spectroscopy）和分子对接（molecular docking），考察了吐根碱-DNA结合的模式及能量学特征。UV-vis光谱在DNA滴定过程中显示出显著的减色和红移效应，表明发色团与碱基对之间存在强相互作用。结合常数（K = 1.10 x 10(6) M(-1)）和吉布斯自由能（DeltaG degrees = -8.26 kcal.mol(-1)）确认了该相互作用为自发的、中等强度的结合。FTIR分析揭示了鸟嘌呤和磷酸基团振动的扰动，与氢键和π-π堆积效应一致。与B-DNA（PDB: 1BNA）的对接模拟识别出一个低能结合构象（DeltaG = -7.13 kcal.mol(-1)），将吐根碱定位在DNA小沟内，并与鸟嘌呤DG4形成氢键。综合光谱和计算数据支持小沟相关结合模型，并为未来吐根碱-DNA相互作用的高分辨率结构研究奠定了基础。
